messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "quieting activity in certain deeper regions of the brain"
set: ["quieting activity in certain deeper regions of the brain", "increasing serotonin activity in the brain", "changing levels of certain chemicals in the brain", "restoring balance of serotonin in the brain", "reducing nerve signals in the brain", "slowing down the outer layer of the brain", "does not work by slowing down the outer layer of the brain", "calming overactive electrical signals in the brain and nervous system", "calming overactive nerve signals in the brain and nervous system", "brain stem", "affects chemicals in the brain that may be unbalanced in people with depression", "affect heart's electrical activity", "blocking action of certain natural substances", "reducing the production of uric acid in the body", "lowering inflammation and immune activity", "decreasing certain chemicals that tighten the blood vessels"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
